examples.text: Rocks, dens, and caves! But I in none of these / Find place or refuge.

glosses: A place providing safety, protection or shelter.

examples.text: One morning I had been driven to the precarious refuge afforded by the steps of the inn, after rejecting offers from the Celebrity to join him in a variety of amusements. examples.text: Since its conception, the European Union has been a haven for those seeking refuge from war, persecution and poverty in other parts of the world.

glosses: To shelter; to protect.
Somewhere one can find protection.
A place where a person or animal may find protection from the elements (especially rain, storms, or cold) sometimes as a place to sleep (such as a cave).

examples.text: The band of explorers found a shelter behind the waterfall, which they rested at for three days.
rock shelter

glosses: Somewhere one can find protection.
A bare-bones above-ground structure meant to provide temporary cover from the elements; usually small and with no door to close.

examples.text: The detective kept them in view. He made his way casually along the inside of the shelter until he reached an open scuttle close to where the two men were standing talking. glosses: Petición que se eleva por escrito ante una autoridad.
En particular, recurso₄ que se presenta para solicitar la revisión de un fallo judicial o administrativo en una instancia superior.
